name: Canmax Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Canmax Technologies Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of comprehensive solutions for electrostatic discharge (ESD) management and cleanroom contamination control. Their product range includes personal protective equipment such as cleanroom garments, shoes, gloves, and ESD control wrist straps. For maintaining sterile environments and protecting sensitive materials, they offer consumables like cleanroom wipers, swabs, shielding bags, specialized ESD packing trays, adhesive tapes, and prescales. The company also provides essential equipment such as sticky mats, rollers, ionizing blowers, and advanced monitoring and static/access control systems. Furthermore, Canmax Technologies produces precision die-cut products, including protective and optical films, and supplies general protective apparel, isolation gowns, and face masks. These critical offerings serve various high-tech sectors, including semiconductor fabrication, data storage, display manufacturing, and telecommunications. Established in 1997 as Suzhou TA&A Ultra Clean Technology Co., Ltd., the company adopted its current name, Canmax Technologies Co., Ltd., in March 2023, and operates from its headquarters in Suzhou, People's Republic of China.
